"차를 빌려서 경쟁했습니다" 10년 만에 사라진 SRT가 코레일에 매년 냈던 돈의 진짜 정체

image_concepts.A: 멈춰 선 보라색 고속열차 앞을 노란 차단바가 가로막은 상징물의 퇴장 구도
image_concepts.B: 파란 장대 편성과 짧은 보라색 열차를 나란히 세운 체급 대비 구도

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 실사. 밝은 차량기지에 멈춰 선 보라색 고속열차 전두부와, 그 앞을 가로막은 노랑·검정 차단바.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic wide shot of a sleek magenta-purple Korean high-speed train nose parked and completely stopped inside a bright, airy railway depot, filling the upper half of the frame from edge to edge. A bold yellow-and-black striped safety barrier stands directly in front of the train, blocking the track. Clean light background with high-key lighting, bright vibrant colors, vivid saturated tones, crisp daylight streaming through large depot windows. Sky-blue and gold accent highlights reflect off the polished carriage body. The composition conveys an operation that has just ended.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 변형. 보라색 차체 측면에서 로고 자리가 비어 있고, 10년치 자국만 남은 클로즈업.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic close-up of the side panel of a magenta-purple Korean high-speed train carriage, occupying the upper half of the frame across its full width. A rectangular patch on the polished bodywork is noticeably cleaner than the surrounding paint, showing where a large logo decal was recently peeled away after ten years. A worker in a bright lime-green safety vest and white helmet stands on a yellow ladder at the far left edge, holding the removed decal. Bright vibrant colors, clean light background, high-key daylight, vivid saturated tones.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 실사. 밝은 승강장에서 파란 장대 편성 고속열차와 훨씬 짧은 보라색 열차가 나란히 선 길이 대비.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic elevated view of two Korean high-speed trains standing side by side at adjacent platforms under a bright open sky, filling the upper half of the frame edge to edge. On the left, a long blue-and-white twenty-car high-speed train stretches far into the distance toward the vanishing point. On the right, a much shorter magenta-purple ten-car train ends less than halfway along the same platform, making the size gap immediately obvious. Bright vibrant colors, clean light background, high-key lighting, vivid saturated tones, sky-blue and gold accents.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 변형. 텅 빈 밝은 승강장에 보라색 열차만 홀로 남고, 옆 선로는 비어 있는 구도.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic platform-level view of a single magenta-purple Korean high-speed train standing alone at a bright, spotless station platform, positioned across the upper half of the frame. The adjacent track beside it is completely empty, leaving a wide vacant gap where a second train would normally be. Sunlight floods the platform through a glass roof, creating a clean light background with high-key lighting, bright vibrant colors and vivid saturated tones. Sky-blue signage and gold-toned platform edging add accent color.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드. 밝은 승강장에 파랑·보라·빨강 고속열차 세 대가 나란히 서서 계보가 색으로 읽히는 구도.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic frontal view of three Korean high-speed train noses lined up side by side at a bright open-air depot, filling the upper half of the frame from edge to edge. From left to right: a blue-and-white train, a magenta-purple train, and a vivid red train, their sleek aerodynamic fronts arranged in a clean row. Bright vibrant colors, clean light background, high-key daylight, vivid saturated tones, sharp reflections on the polished nose cones. Sky-blue sky and gold sunlight accents complete the scene.
